title: Compliance rules
description: Set of regulatory rules per market. Each rule defines a check applied to a component's `specifications`. The compliance_check tool walks the rule list and, for each rule whose market and category match, evaluates the component's spec field against the rule's check. The fixture in data/compliance-rules.seed.json is the source of truth; production would back this with a maintained regulatory database.

regulation.description: Full citation of the regulation, e.g. 'RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU'.

applies_to_categories.description: If present, the rule only applies to components whose `category` is in this list. If absent, the rule applies to every component.

severity.description: blocking = cannot be placed on the market; warning = saleable but documentation gap exists.

oneOf.description: Component spec value at `spec_field` must be <= `threshold`.
Component spec value at `spec_field` must be exactly `true`.

spec_field.description: Component spec field that holds an array of CAS numbers (strings).

oneOf.description: Each CAS number listed in `spec_field` is cross-referenced against the ECHA SVHC Candidate List in data/svhc-cache.json. A violation is raised if any match is found.
